label: Text Editor
description: Titan's text editor. Opens, edits and saves text files, and can read or write a file without opening a window.

actions.name: get_status
actions.summary: Say which document the text editor has open, how long it is and whether it has unsaved changes.

actions.name: get_text
actions.summary: Read the text of the document open in the editor.

actions.name: open_file
actions.summary: Open a text file in the editor.

path.description: Full path of the file to open.

actions.name: insert_text
actions.summary: Insert text at the cursor in the open document.

actions.name: set_text
actions.summary: Replace the whole document with new text.

actions.name: replace_text
actions.summary: Find and replace text in the open document.

replace.description: Text to put in its place (empty deletes it).

all.description: Replace every occurrence (default) or only the first.

actions.name: save_as
actions.summary: Save the open document under a new name.

actions.name: read_file
actions.summary: Read a text file. Does not open a window.

actions.name: write_file
actions.summary: Create or overwrite a text file. Does not open a window.

actions.name: append_file
actions.summary: Add text to the end of a file. Does not open a window.
